title: Practice 1: Two verbs for every way of going

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Ты ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 2nd sg.)? Еда остывает.
exercises.why: **идёшь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: Are you coming? The food's getting cold.

exercises.q: Май ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) после апреля.
exercises.why: **идёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: May comes after April.

exercises.q: Вот что ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) в расчёт.
exercises.why: **идёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: That's what counts.

exercises.q: Дело ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) полным ходом.
exercises.why: **идёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: The case is well underway.

exercises.q: Дорога ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) вдоль моря.
exercises.why: **идёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: The road goes along the sea.

exercises.q: Сейчас я ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 1st sg.) на рынок.
exercises.why: **иду** — present tense (1st person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: Now I go to the market.

exercises.q: Как ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) поиски работы?
exercises.why: **идут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: How is your job search going?

exercises.q: Я ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 1st sg.) к своей бабушке.
exercises.why: **иду** — present tense (1st person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: I'm going to my grandmother's.

exercises.q: Я ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 1st sg.) в театр на углу.
exercises.why: **иду** — present tense (1st person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: I'm going to the theater on the corner.

exercises.q: Я ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 1st sg.) в поход с Томом.
exercises.why: **иду** — present tense (1st person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: I'm going camping with Tom.

exercises.q: Куда ты в точности ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 2nd sg.)?
exercises.why: **идёшь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: Where are you going exactly?

exercises.q: Перелётные птицы ___ (лететь — to fly, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) к югу.
exercises.why: **летят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).
exercises.prompt: Migrating birds are flying south.

exercises.q: Ты какой авиакомпанией ___ (лететь — to fly, one way; impf., pres. 2nd sg.)?
exercises.why: **летишь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).
exercises.prompt: Which airline are you flying with?

exercises.q: Дурная молва на крыльях ___ (лететь — to fly, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.).
exercises.why: **летит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).
exercises.prompt: Ill news comes apace.

exercises.q: Ты ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 2nd sg.) на теннисный корт?
exercises.why: **идёшь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: Are you going to the tennis court?

exercises.q: Вы ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 2nd pl.) на теннисный корт?
exercises.why: **идёте** — present tense (2nd person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: Are you going to the tennis court?

exercises.q: Ты ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 2nd sg.) к Тому на отвальную?
exercises.why: **идёшь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: Are you going to Tom's farewell party?

exercises.q: История ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) окольными путями.
exercises.why: **идет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: The story goes in a roundabout way.

exercises.q: Эта санкция ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) гораздо дальше.
exercises.why: **идет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: This sanction goes much further.

exercises.q: Когда ты ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way; impf., pres. 2nd sg.) в Йорк?
exercises.why: **едешь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).
exercises.prompt: When are you going to York?
